Raw FishBase key tables

Source: R/dimoose.R
rawhtml.Rd

An R6 object holding a FishBase key's description and its couplet table as downloaded, before conversion to a dimoose object.

Active bindings

desc

Key title (read-only).

df

The key's couplet table: one row per lead, with columns Statement, Choice, Character, Next, Prev and Taxon.

rawhtml$new()

Download a FishBase key.

Usage

rawhtml$new(
  keycode,
  fishbaseUrl = "https://www.fishbase.se/",
  separateTerms = TRUE
)

Arguments

keycode

FishBase key code.

fishbaseUrl

Base URL of the FishBase mirror.

separateTerms

Ignored; kept for backward compatibility.
